title: Putnami Workspace Configuration
description: Workspace-level configuration file (putnami.workspace.json). Placed at workspace root (~/.putnami/config.json for global, or workspace root for workspace-level).

name.description: Workspace name. Used as display name for the workspace.

output.description: Default output format for CLI commands.

baseline.description: Default git ref used by --impacted when --baseline is not provided.

epicBranches.description: Long-lived integration branch names or globs (e.g. 'epic/*'). Without --baseline, --impacted measures a branch against the nearest of these branches or the trunk — never against the branch itself.

profile.description: Default deployment profile. Resolved with precedence: --profile flag > PUTNAMI_PROFILE env > this value > dev.

includes.description: Workspace membership paths relative to the workspace root. Each entry may point to an autonomous scope directory or a direct project directory.

options.description: Per-command and per-extension parameter defaults. Keys: '*' (global defaults), command names ('build'), extension names ('@putnami/typescript'), or qualified names ('@putnami/typescript:build').

cache-trust.description: Remote-cache trust policy for this command: ci accepts only trusted provider entries, any accepts hints and legacy entries, and none disables remote caching.

cpu-policy.description: How each task's exported CPU ceiling is derived: critical-path sizes it by the task's share of the plan's makespan, floored by measured occupancy; measured uses measured occupancy alone. Execution hint only — never affects cache keys.

aliases.description: Command aliases mapping alias name to target command.

oneOf.description: Extension references as array. Prefer extension names (for example @putnami/go).
Extension version map. Maps extension names to version constraints (for example { "@putnami/go": "^1.0.0" }).

extensions.description: Extensions configuration. Accepts either an array of names or a version map with constraints.

registries.description: Registry endpoints, one entry per ecosystem id (npm, go, oci, put, …). The keys of an entry are defined by that ecosystem's profile, declared by the extension that owns it; this schema validates only the outer map. A project may override an entry in its own putnami.json, and the override replaces the entry whole.

projectAliases.description: Project aliases (alias → target project ID). Aggregated with scope-level projectAliases; duplicates are an error.

groups.description: Project groups (group name → pattern). Aggregated with scope-level groups; duplicates are an error.

templates.description: Template paths or references for project scaffolding.

agentArtifacts.description: Opt-ins, spelled `extension:<name>`, into the agent content of a declared extension, materialized into this workspace at the version the extension resolves to. The forms earlier releases installed — registry references (`name` or `name:channel`) and in-tree project paths (`/path`) — are refused; `putnami migrate agent-content <name>` moves them to the extension whose content supersedes them. A CLI that predates the opt-in reads `extension:<name>` as an agent artifact named `extension`, which no lock pins, and its install fails with nothing written.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks at the workspace level.

commands.description: Per-command lifecycle hooks. Keys are command names.

disable.description: Opt-out configuration for extensions and jobs.

extensions.description: Extension names to disable (opt-out). Extensions are auto-discovered from devDependencies and workspace packages.

jobs.description: Jobs to disable workspace-wide. Supports job names ('lint') or qualified names ('@putnami/typescript:lint').

tags.description: Project tags to exclude from default project selection (e.g., skip 'e2e' projects in --all and --impacted runs).

store.description: Machine-global build store garbage-collection tuning. Resolution precedence: PUTNAMI_STORE_* env vars > workspace config > global config > defaults. The store location itself is set only via PUTNAMI_STORE_DIR (machine-specific).

maxBytes.description: Global byte budget across all per-repo stores (default 10 GiB). GC evicts least-recently-used entries when usage exceeds this.

gcGrace.description: Go duration (e.g. '1h', '30m') protecting recently-used and in-flight cache entries from eviction (default '1h'). Must comfortably exceed your longest build.

maxIdleBuilds.description: Evict entries not hit in this many builds, regardless of budget (default 100). 0 disables idle reclaim.

sessions.description: Per-worktree session-record retention for <workspace>/.putnami/sessions. Resolution precedence: workspace config > global config > default. There is deliberately no environment override: session records are per-worktree, unlike the machine-global build store.

keep.description: How many session directories the store retains when it prunes (default 20). The minimum of 1 rules out 0, which could be read as either 'unlimited' or 'delete everything'.

before.description: Commands to run before the phase.

after.description: Commands to run after the phase.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds applied to each command of this hook group. Omitted or <= 0 uses the CLI default of 120000.

loginShell.description: Run this group's commands through a login shell (sh -lc), sourcing /etc/profile and ~/.profile. Off by default: a login shell makes hooks depend on per-developer dotfiles. Opt in only when a hook needs a version-manager PATH.
